---
name: Ask GPT-2 anything
about: GPT-2 (124M), stored as Markdown files, answers via a GitHub Action
title: "gpt2: "
---

Put your question or the start of any text in the **title** after `gpt2:`, then Submit. A bot replies with GPT-2's continuation (about a minute) and closes this issue. Leave this body as is.

Tip: end the title with `?` and it is asked as `Question: ... Answer:`.
